title: Small covers as pullbacks from the simplex
summary: We introduce and study small covers that are pullbacks from the simplex, extending pullbacks from the linear model. Our main result gives several equivalent characterizations of this class, including torsion-freeness of odd-degree integral cohomology, vanishing of the first Steenrod square on even-degree mod $2$ cohomology, and relations among integral and mod $2$ Betti numbers.
